cues.text: Record what was actually done and observed, with the configuration,
cues.spoken: Record what was actually done and observed, with the configuration,

cues.text: instruments, conditions and execution details.
cues.spoken: instruments, conditions and execution details.

cues.text: A copied expected result is not an observation.
cues.spoken: A copied expected result is not an observation.

cues.text: If a step was not executed, say so and retain the reason.
cues.spoken: If a step was not executed, say so and retain the reason.

cues.text: Distinguish a justified exclusion from a test that could not be completed.
cues.spoken: Distinguish a justified exclusion from a test that could not be completed.

cues.text: Retain applicable original records, raw electronic data, printouts
cues.spoken: Retain applicable original records, raw electronic data, printouts

cues.text: and photographs under the defined retention arrangements.
cues.spoken: and photographs under the defined retention arrangements.

cues.text: Link summaries to those originals.
cues.spoken: Link summaries to those originals.

cues.text: The required period depends on the record
cues.spoken: The required period depends on the record

cues.text: and applicable obligations; this module supplies no universal number.
cues.spoken: and applicable obligations; this module supplies no universal number.

cues.text: Preserve readability, access and integrity
cues.spoken: Preserve readability, access and integrity

cues.text: rather than keeping only a polished report screenshot.
cues.spoken: rather than keeping only a polished report screenshot.

cues.text: If logging stops during a test,
cues.spoken: If logging stops during a test,

cues.text: retain the partial record and document what happened.
cues.spoken: retain the partial record and document what happened.

cues.text: Assess which conclusions the gap affects.
cues.spoken: Assess which conclusions the gap affects.

cues.text: Do not fill the missing interval from memory or copy another run.
cues.spoken: Do not fill the missing interval from memory or copy another run.

cues.text: Any continuation or repeat needs the defined procedure,
cues.spoken: Any continuation or repeat needs the defined procedure,

cues.text: a documented rationale and a clear relationship to the first record.
cues.spoken: a documented rationale and a clear relationship to the first record.

cues.text: Corrections must preserve the original entry
cues.spoken: Corrections must preserve the original entry

cues.text: and identify the change according to the applicable record controls.
cues.spoken: and identify the change according to the applicable record controls.

cues.text: For paper, avoid obscuring the earlier value.
cues.spoken: For paper, avoid obscuring the earlier value.

cues.text: For electronic records, use the authorized correction mechanism
cues.spoken: For electronic records, use the authorized correction mechanism

cues.text: and applicable audit trail.
cues.spoken: and applicable audit trail.

cues.text: A reviewer should be able to reconstruct the chronology
cues.spoken: A reviewer should be able to reconstruct the chronology

cues.text: rather than encounter an unexplained clean replacement.
